descriptions.en: Android companion for your own DSH Host with QR pairing, end-to-end encrypted tunnel transport, official features, and a mobile layout.
descriptions.zh: 连接自有 DSH Host 的 Android 配套应用，提供扫码配对、端到端加密隧道、官方功能和手机布局。

notice.en: Requires dsh-mobile-pairing on the Host. The v1.1.14 release is a signed APK (versionCode 27) with IndexedDB Host plugin cache, the mobile layout, and plugin settings surfaces.
notice.zh: 需要在 Host 安装 dsh-mobile-pairing。v1.1.14 是 versionCode 27 的正式签名 APK，包含 IndexedDB Host 插件缓存、移动布局和插件设置界面。
